names.ice_cream_works_1605_indiana: 1605–1613 Indiana Avenue — the Thompson-Reid and Collins Bros. ice-cream works, building

source.citation: Abendpost (Chicago), 22 March 1904, vol. 16, no. 69, 'Gewaltsames Ende': the report of a labourer buried and killed by falling earth that day while digging a foundation at No. 1605-1613 Indiana Ave.
what_it_does_not_supply: how far the building had risen by 1 July 1904
what_it_supplies: 1605-1613 Indiana was an excavation for a foundation in March 1904
